appDescription: A long inland stage from Lönhult to Krokstorp, starting by the Lönhult cabin and the Hultsfred-Kristdala road before passing Skinshult, Sjöändemåla, Möllekulla, Tvingen, Karlsfors, Storyttern and the Påskallesten area. Official text highlights swimming at Tvingen and Storyttern, the old mill/waterfall at Karlsfors, Ytteryd house foundations and Krokstorpsjön near the end. Field reports repeatedly describe this stage as harder to follow and rougher than the map distance alone suggests, and Krokstorp water needs cautious treatment.

campingRules: Tenting by Ostkustleden cabins has a 50 SEK/person fee according to current official pages.
General allemansrätten guidance allows short responsible tenting outside private home zones/crops/plantings, but route/cabin-specific and protected-area restrictions override general guidance.
Close gates and avoid crops/plantings according to Döderhult guidance.
fireRules: Lönhult cabin: outdoor fires are not allowed.
Krokstorp cabin: all fireplaces in the cabin are prohibited and outdoor fires by the cabin are not allowed.
Oskarshamn reported no municipal fire ban on 2026-04-29, but same-day fire-ban and fire-risk checks remain required.

hunting.notes: Naturkartan API included a seasonal hunting notice: elk hunting October 8-January 31, respect jakt pågår signs, wear visible clothing, stay on trail, and choose another area if active hunting is underway. Not an active elk-season closure on 2026-04-29.

closuresAndCurrentness.notes: No closure or reroute found on official pages checked. Naturkartan API record was last modified 2026-04-27 and had no trail-status report.
No route-specific forestry closure found online. Follow local worksite signs and avoid machinery areas.

routeFinding.notes: Multiple older section-specific reports describe indistinct markings or wrong turns, and a 2025 whole-route AllTrails review warns third-party route lines can be stale. Treat route-finding as a real Etapp 3 caution.

accessRules.notes: KLT Närtrafik must be booked and does not allow pets except approved service dogs; regular KLT buses/trains have separate pet placement rules.

conditionReports.details: Direct Etapp 3 report calls it the toughest of the author's first six Ostkustleden stages: hilly, overgrown, rutted clearcuts, partly wet/muddy and rocky, poorly marked in places, and took 8 hours. Reports Krokstorp well water very low with sediment/debris and Krokstorpssjön red-brown/iron-rich. Notes Krokstorp cabin is not the first cabin by the lake/bathing place.

Trip/photos from 2017-07-26 confirm two-car logistics, rough fields/dense vegetation, Krokstorp electricity/hotplate usefulness, and cloudy/slimy Krokstorp well water; hikers bought bottled water in Oskarshamn.
Photo evidence supporting poor Krokstorp well-water quality in 2017.

Partial Etapp 3 walk Lönhult-Karlsfors. First about 2 km asphalt/gravel road, Sjöändemåla area beautiful, signed BAD 50 m side trip at Tvingen, heavy rain, and indistinct marking caused two wrong turns.
Direct Etapp 3 report found the stage less demanding than the 2015 account but independently flagged Krokstorp well and lake water as uninviting, with suspended matter filtered from the well.
Whole-route review, not Etapp 3-specific, says cabins are excellent but the route can be hard to follow and AllTrails line may be old.
Route-app listing gives 13 mi, hard, last updated 2026-04-01, but no useful review text.

sourceContradictions.details: Naturkartan page says 20.5 km, normalized GPX computes 20.549165 km with small joins, Döderhult/OSM/Pacer round to about 21 km, and raw GPX concatenation gives a false 54.841849 km because tracks are not in route order.
